Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone mats. Cream together butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy (3-5 minutes). Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition, then stir in vanilla extract. Dissolve baking soda in 2 teaspoons of hot water and add to the batter with salt. Gradually mix in flour until just combined, then add baking powder. Fold in chocolate chips. Drop spoonfuls of dough onto prepared sheets, leaving space for spreading. Bake for about 10 minutes until edges are browned. Cool on sheets for 2 minutes, then transfer to wire racks to cool completely.
